items.title: VN-Index closes higher as banks lead the rally
items.content: The benchmark VN-Index gained 1.2% on Tuesday, powered by banking heavyweights and foreign inflows into large caps.

items.title: Inflation cools to a nine-month low in July
items.content: Consumer prices rose 2.1% year on year in July, giving the central bank room to keep policy supportive through year-end.

items.title: FPT signs AI partnership with regional cloud provider
items.content: FPT Corporation announced a cooperation agreement to deploy AI workloads across Southeast Asia, lifting its technology services outlook.

items.title: VN-Index drops on profit-taking after five-day rally
items.content: The index retreated 0.8% as traders locked in gains, though turnover remained above the 20-day average.

items.title: State bank holds policy rate steady at 4.5%
items.content: The State Bank of Vietnam kept its refinancing rate unchanged, citing stable inflation and adequate liquidity in the banking system.

items.title: Vinfast reports record quarterly EV deliveries
items.content: Vinfast delivered more than 32,000 electric vehicles in the quarter, up 45% from the previous period, beating market estimates.

items.title: Foreign investors turn net buyers for third straight week
items.content: Overseas funds poured $180 million into HoSE-listed shares this week, the strongest inflow streak since March.

items.title: Vietnam's manufacturing PMI edges back into expansion
items.content: The S&P Global PMI rose to 50.6 in July, signalling renewed growth in output and new export orders.

items.title: Blockchain firm partners with two Hanoi banks for KYC
items.content: A local fintech will provide digital identity and KYC services to two commercial banks, expanding its enterprise pipeline.

items.title: Regulator tightens disclosure rules for listed firms
items.content: The new circular requires companies to publish quarterly reports within 20 days, up from 30, starting October 2026.

items.title: Real estate stocks rally on housing loan stimulus
items.content: Developers and homebuilders advanced after a new credit package lowered mortgage rates for first-time buyers.

items.title: Export growth accelerates as electronics rebound
items.content: Shipments rose 11.4% in July, led by smartphones and semiconductor assembly, easing pressure on the trade balance.

items.title: Pharmaceutical firm wins tender for 10 provinces
items.content: A leading pharma manufacturer secured a government procurement contract valued at over VND 800 billion.

items.title: Viettel launches 5G standalone network commercially
items.content: The telco switched on nationwide 5G SA coverage, claiming peak speeds of 1.4 Gbps and new enterprise use cases.

items.title: VN-Index reclaims 1,300 points on steel and cement gains
items.content: Construction materials rallied on infrastructure spending headlines, lifting the benchmark back above the key level.

items.title: FDI pledges reach $18 billion in the first seven months
items.content: Registered foreign direct investment rose 8% year on year, with manufacturing and energy drawing the largest shares.

items.title: Exchange sets new daily turnover record of VND 35 trillion
items.content: HoSE recorded its busiest session ever as retail participation surged, pushing liquidity past previous highs.

items.title: Fintech startup raises $25 million Series B
items.content: The Hanoi-based payments company will use the funds to expand buy-now-pay-later services across the region.

items.title: FLC Aviation agrees to order 20 regional jets
items.content: The charter carrier signed a memorandum of understanding for 20 aircraft, renewing its domestic expansion plans.

items.title: Securities watchdog fines three brokers for order routing
items.content: Regulators imposed penalties totalling VND 4 billion for failures in order execution and client reporting systems.

items.title: Retail sales climb 9% as tourism season peaks
items.content: Strong domestic demand and record international arrivals boosted consumer spending across the summer months.

items.title: Steel maker expands plant to meet export demand
items.content: The company announced a new rolling line with capacity of 1.2 million tonnes, targeting the ASEAN market.

items.title: Insurers launch digital claims processing platform
items.content: Three major insurers rolled out AI-assisted claims review, cutting average payout time from days to hours.

items.title: New derivatives products expected to debut next quarter
items.content: The exchange is preparing index futures on new benchmarks, subject to final approval from the securities commission.
